caption: The drawing depicts a circular, metallic flask with a narrow neck and a flat body, primarily colored in shades of muted yellow, gold, and olive green, creating a tarnished brass effect. In the center of the body, there is an engraved decorative motif featuring a rooster surrounded by stylized, swirling floral patterns and vines. The outer rim of the flask is thick and features small, evenly spaced, dark round studs or rivets. At the top, the flask has a relatively short, cylindrical neck and a small loop or tab suggesting a point for attachment or hanging. To the right side of the main illustration, there is a smaller side-view sketch of the flask, showing its narrow profile and the position of the neck. The background is a plain off-white or very light beige with some brown discoloration and marks. The artist’s signature, "V.L. VANCE," appears in small letters in the bottom left quadrant of the image.
title: Bed Warming Pan
